subject.title: exec yieldMs blocks Discord listener — MESSAGE_CREATE delays up to 625 seconds

question: While a Discord session has an active agent turn, should new text messages remain queued in order, or should selected messages be allowed to cancel or steer that run?
rationale: Current main intentionally preserves per-session ordering, so making the bot responsive to later messages during an active turn changes conversation and session semantics rather than repairing a synchronous event-loop block.

options.title: Preserve ordered execution
options.body: Keep later messages queued, but expose a visible busy state and a clear cancellation path for long-running turns.

options.title: Support live steering
options.body: Allow eligible new messages to steer, cancel, or otherwise affect the active run while preserving ordinary follow-up ordering.

options.title: Lower the global yield ceiling
options.body: Force foreground exec calls to background sooner across all channels, accepting the compatibility change for existing tool behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve ordered execution
recommendation.body: Keep later messages queued, but expose a visible busy state and a clear cancellation path for long-running turns.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is recent ownership of the exec lifecycle implementation where global yield behavior is defined.
